messages:
omar: FYI @channel — starting 07:07 UTC we saw a surge of 429s from auth-proxy in eu-west. Routing fanout + short TCP spikes caused token issuance backpressure. Opening incident thread.
rebecca: Observed client-side retries magnifying load. Root cause appears to be a mis-tuned backoff in the new client lib rollout.
kai: Mitigations applied: 1) temporarily limited per-route max concurrency on edge proxies, 2) rate-limited internal retries, 3) scaled auth-proxy pool by +20% in eu-west. Error rate down from ~3.1% -> 0.2% in 12m.
omar: Customer impact: intermittent 429s for hosted API customers in eu-west, ~30 accounts affected. CS alerted; draft outbound note: https://redwood.internal/notes/auth-backpressure-eu (review please).
rebecca: Plan: rollback client lib tweak in next staging -> prod rollout; add a circuit-breaker in auth-proxy to fail fast under overload. PRs will reference this thread.
kai: ops-bot: rollback job queued id=rb-2277; scaling action completed id=scale-2277. Monitoring dashboards: https://status.redwood.com/incidents/2277654321/live
status-bot: Current severity: P2 (partial customer impact). Keeping channel open for 45m observation. Postmortem owner: rebecca.
omar: Action items assigned: rebecca (postmortem + comms), kai (hardening + CB), omar (status updates). Closing initial broadcast; will update if regression. :thumbsup:
